name: Ismail Testimonial Slider
author: Md. Ismail Hossain

sections.description:
Ismail Testimonial Slider helps you display your client feedback in a beautiful and professional way. This plugin provides a dedicated dashboard menu to manage your testimonials easily. You can showcase your client success stories on any page or post using a shortcode. The slider is powered by Slick Slider, ensuring smooth transitions and a responsive layout that works perfectly on all devices.

Features

  • Fully Responsive and Touch-Friendly.
  • Slick Slider Integration for smooth performance.
  • Easy to customize and integrate via Shortcode.
  • Clean, lightweight, and optimized code for faster loading.
  • Simple admin interface to manage testimonials.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Use the shortcode [ismt_testimonial] in any page or post.
sections.faq:
How do I add testimonials?

After activation, you will see a ‘Testimonials’ menu in your WordPress dashboard. Navigate there to add, edit, or delete your testimonial items.

How do I display the slider?

Simply copy the shortcode [ismt_testimonial] and paste it into the editor of your desired page, post, or widget area.
